Project: Django. Upgrade: 3.2 -> 4.2. Release of these items: 4.1.
Source: Django 4.1 release notes.

Label every item:
- risk = the change could break an application or deployment, require migration work, or create operational risk for SOME user upgrading across this release (removed or renamed APIs/settings/flags, changed defaults, behavior changes, raised minimum versions of runtimes/databases/dependencies, data or schema migration, required config changes, deprecated-and-removed features).
- context = accurate and useful but needs no user action at this release: explicitly "no user action required", a deprecation that still works (warning only), a purely additive new feature or option, documentation pointers.
- noise = credits, install/download commands, pure bug fixes that cannot change correct behavior, marketing text, headings with no content.

Return one label per item_id with a one-sentence reason grounded in the item text.

Items (JSON lines):
{"item_id": "5a2388d7b867", "section": "Django 4.1 release notes / Features removed in 4.1", "text": "TransactionTestCase.assertQuerysetEqual() no longer calls repr() on a queryset when compared to string values."}
{"item_id": "8f6ba3148481", "section": "Django 4.1 release notes / Features removed in 4.1", "text": "The django.core.cache.backends.memcached.MemcachedCache backend is removed."}
{"item_id": "c7948d8294cb", "section": "Django 4.1 release notes / Features removed in 4.1", "text": "Support for the pre-Django 3.2 format of messages used by django.contrib.messages.storage.cookie.CookieStorage is removed."}

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing repr() comparison behavior in assertQuerysetEqual() changes test outcomes and can break existing test suites that relied on the old string comparison.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The MemcachedCache backend is removed, so deployments using it must migrate to PyMemcacheCache or PyLibMCCache or they will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for the pre-3.2 cookie message format is removed, so existing cookies in that format will no longer be read and users may lose messages during upgrade.
